BiblicalUsage: Rephael was the son of Shemaiah, a gatekeeper of the temple, one of the sons of Obed-edom, mighty men of valour whose hands God had strengthened for the service. His father's house kept the gates of the temple, and the gatekeepers are counted among the mighty men of valour.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that the gatekeeper's name is kept because the gate is kept, and no service in God's house is small.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
